entities.summary: Choi Dae-hoon is a South Korean actor known for his roles in the dramas Beyond Evil (2021) and When Life Gives You Tangerines (2025). He was nominated for Best Supporting Actor – Television at the 57th Baeksang Arts Awards for Beyond Evil and won the same award at the 61st Baeksang Arts Awards for When Life Gives You Tangerines.
